Name: Monsters from Dragon Quest (CP)
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]This mod turns many monsters into monsters from Dragon Quest. :)

[img]https://abload.de/img/buttons1jtd.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Install the latest version of Content Patcher.
3. Download the mod anywhere and then unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.



[img]https://abload.de/img/button3bljhi.png[/img]

To uninstall, just delete it from the mods folder.

The following monsters are affected:

Bat
Big Slime
Blue Squid
Bug
Carbon Ghost
Duggy
Dust Spirit
Fly
Frost Bat
Ghost
Green Slime
Haunted Skull
Lava Bat
Lava Crab
Metal Head
Mummy
Putrid Ghost
Rock Crab
Royal Serpent
Serpent
Shadow Brute
Shadow Shaman
Skeleton Mage
Skeleton
Squid Kid
Stone Golem
Wilderness Golem

I plan on doing the "dangerous" variants eventually as well. :)[/center]
